claims.text: Injury above T6–T7 (↓sympathetic output to the heart): vasopressors w chronotropic and inotropic effects (eg, norepinephrine, dopamine);
claims.quote: Injuries above T6–T7, because they compromise sympathetic output to the thoracic cardiopulmonary nerves, are treated with vasopressors that have chronotropic and inotropic effects such as norepinephrine and dopamine.
claims.locator: Maintenance of oxygenation and spinal cord perfusion

claims.text: lesions below T7 may respond to pure vasoconstrictors (eg, phenylephrine).
claims.quote: Lesions below T7 may respond sufficiently to pure vasoconstrictors such as phenylephrine
claims.locator: Maintenance of oxygenation and spinal cord perfusion
